whyChooseUs.quote: [TA] What is old must not be antique, it must be alive.

faq.title: [TA] Before You Begin
faq.quote: [TA] Ask freely, clarity is itself a first remedy.

items.q: [TA] How is a traditional consultation different from an online report?
items.a: [TA] A shastric reading examines the interplay of chart, dasha, transits and lineage. Every remedy prescribed considers your capacity to practise it.

items.q: [TA] What information do I need to share before booking?
items.a: [TA] Your date of birth, exact time of birth as close as possible, and place of birth. If unknown, we can perform a rectification session first.

items.q: [TA] Are the remedies difficult to follow?
items.a: [TA] Remedies are always calibrated to your life. Some are as simple as a mantra at dawn; others involve pooja on specific tithis.
[TA] Absolutely. Every reading, chart and personal detail remains strictly between you and the astrologer.
[TA] Yes. Most clients return once or twice a year, and during significant dasha transitions or life events.
